title: Stop leaking secrets in logs
description: `src/redact.ts` is used to sanitize objects and URLs before they are written to logs, but it leaks secrets: it only masks a top-level key named exactly `password`, ignores nested data, mutates its input and does not touch URLs or strings containing credentials. Rewrite it so it follows the rules in the doc comments and `test/redact.test.ts` passes. It must never throw, never mutate its input and never leak a secret value.
